fun_facts: Jayden Daniels was born in San Bernardino, California.
He began his college career at Arizona State before transferring to LSU.
In one game at LSU, he totaled 606 yards and became the first FBS quarterback to throw for at least 350 yards and rush for at least 200 yards in a game.
In 2023, he became the first SEC player since Johnny Manziel in 2012 to record at least 3,500 passing yards and 1,000 rushing yards in a season.
In his first five NFL games, he became the first player in NFL history to exceed 1,000 passing yards and 250 rushing yards.

As a fifth-year senior for LSU last season, Daniels threw for 3,812 yards and 40 touchdowns with only four interceptions. He also ran 135 times for 1,134 yards and eight touchdowns. He started 55 games in his college career, including all 29 contests he played over three seasons at Arizona State, which is where he began his college career.

"To us, he was special in every way, on the field and off the field," he said.

excerpts:
[Jayden Daniels](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4426348/jayden-daniels) is the 2023 Heisman Trophy winner.

## Editor's Picks

He had 3,500 passing yards and 1,000 rushing yards this season, becoming the first SEC player to do so since Johnny Manziel in 2012.

The win also makes Daniels the second California native to earn the Heisman award in the last three years -- Bryce Young won in 2021. Before Young, California native Reggie Bush won the Heisman in 2005.

Here are the key numbers behind Daniels' Heisman-winning season.

**50:** Daniels found the end zone often throughout the season. He had an FBS high 50 total touchdowns, 40 passing and 10 rushing, the fifth SEC player to do so -- Young (2021), Burrow (2019), Cam Newton (2010) and Tim Tebow (2007).

excerpts: -- [Jayden Daniels](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4426348/jayden-daniels) accounted for 606 total yards and five touchdowns as he became the first quarterback in FBS history to have at least 350 passing yards and 200 rushing yards in a game as No. 19 [LSU](https://www.espn.com/college-football/team/_/id/99/lsu-tigers) defeated

Daniels continued to make his Heisman Trophy case, leading the Tigers (7-3, 5-2 SEC) to touchdowns on five consecutive second-half possessions, completing 17 of 26 passes for 372 yards and three touchdowns and running 12 times for 234 yards and two touchdowns.

"If [Daniels] didn't win [the Heisman Trophy] tonight, he has got to be the leading candidate," LSU coach Brian Kelly said.

Apr 25, 2024 at 08:26 PM

[Zach Selby](https://www.commanders.com/author/zach-selby)

Senior Writer

[](https://twitter.com/ZachSelbyWC) [](mailto:zach.selby@commanders.com)

* 
* 
* 
*

The Washington Commanders have selected LSU quarterback Jayden Daniels with the No. 2 overall pick in the 2024 NFL Draft.

Daniels, who started his college career at Arizona State before transferring to LSU, completed 65% of his passes for 12,749 yards with 89 touchdowns and 20 interceptions. Daniels also adds dynamic ability as a runner, ranking first among quarterbacks in 2023 with 1,134 yards and 10 touchdowns.
